resources.string: Live notification details
Show Doze state changes in the notification. Leave off to keep the monitor notification quiet and stable.
Include last session in notification
Include session duration and battery change when live notification details are enabled.
Restrict sensor access during Doze
Restrict SensorService clients while in Doze, then restore access on wake. This includes motion sensors; it does not prove physical sensors are powered off. See Diagnostics for saved verification.
Sensors Off privacy switch during Doze
Request Android’s Sensors Off privacy control, including camera and microphone. Manufacturer support and privileged permission are required. See Diagnostics for the actual result.
Unavailable on Android 16: the old biometrics setting is not a reliable control for fingerprint and face unlock. Saved selections are ignored.
Turn off Location during Doze
Turn off the system Location setting during Doze and restore it on wake. This affects location access beyond GPS.
Uses local phone time. Android may delay schedule boundaries while asleep; eligibility is checked again on device events.
